page.overview:
Who is Caseosaurus?

(meaning "Case's lizard) is a dubious genus of saurischian dinosaur that lived approximately 221.5 to 212 million years ago during the latter part of the Triassic Period in what is now Texas (USA), in North America. It was a small, lightly-built, bipedal, ground-dwelling carnivore, and could grow up to 2 m (6.6 ft) long.

Caseosaurus was featured in the Jurassic Park Institute now available to browse on Dinopedia.
